agent.actionSurface.description: How the agent acts: cells-only (one cell tool and finish) or hybrid (cells plus direct read, edit and bash tools).

edit.guard.description: What editing a range the agent has not read does: off, warn, or require reading it first (an error).

values.previewLimits.description: The bounds of value previews shown to models: characters, items, depth and string length.

values.inlineMaxBytes.description: The largest value, in bytes of JSON, that is copied inline; larger values travel as blob references.

values.argumentMaxBytes.description: The largest argument of a host call, in bytes of JSON, that a cell passes inline (a file's text, a command's input).

shell.windows.description: The shell that runs scripts on Windows: pwsh (PowerShell 7) or powershell (Windows PowerShell).

goal.context.description: How a goal's iterations carry context: continue, compact, or fresh-handoff (a fresh session with a handoff).

model.role.main.description: The model for the main role, as provider/model; null until configured.

model.role.fast.description: The model for the fast role, as provider/model; null until configured.

model.role.summarizer.description: The model for the summarizer role, as provider/model; null until configured.

model.role.review.description: The model for the review role, as provider/model; null until configured.

model.role.judge.description: The model for the judge role, as provider/model; null until configured.

model.role.embed.description: The model for the embed role, as provider/model; null until configured.

description: Variant selections: slot ids and their values.
